incident.title: Assistant recommending specific funds to buy
incident.summary: Users are getting replies like "buy Northstar Flexi Cap now" from the assistant since late morning (around 11:45 IST). The assistant team shipped a new prompt this morning.
incident.userImpact: Regulatory exposure from unlicensed investment advice.

history.title: Mandate registrations failing across all banks
history.symptoms: Mandate success fell to 40% across banks for 25 minutes.
history.resolution: Waited for NPCI recovery; queued retries afterwards.

history.title: Assistant tone change produced advice-like phrasing
history.symptoms: Users read "consider increasing your SIP" as advice.
history.rootCause: Prompt tone change; compliance filter allowed borderline phrasing.

history.title: Brief login failures during cache failover
history.symptoms: Login errors for 3 minutes; sessions invalidated for some users.
history.rootCause: Cache primary failed over; session keys on the old primary were not replicated in time.
history.resolution: Enabled synchronous replication for the sessions keyspace.

history.title: OTP SMS delivery delays for one telecom circle
history.symptoms: OTP SMS arriving 2-5 minutes late for users on one telecom circle; login completion dropped about 8%.
history.rootCause: SMS provider routing degradation for one operator; our sends were accepted but delivery receipts lagged.
history.resolution: Provider rerouted traffic; we added delivery-receipt latency alerting.

history.title: Assistant quoted a wrong exit load for one fund
history.symptoms: Support tickets: assistant said exit load is nil for a fund that charges 1% within a year.
history.rootCause: Help article for that fund had a typo; the index served it correctly.
history.resolution: Fixed the article; added factsheet-vs-article consistency check.

history.title: Assistant timeouts during LLM provider incident
history.symptoms: About 12% of assistant answers timed out for 40 minutes.
history.rootCause: LLM provider regional outage (5xx and long tails).
history.resolution: Provider recovered; we added a fallback model route.

history.title: Push notifications failing for older Android app versions
history.symptoms: Push failures up 4x for Android app versions below 6.2.
history.rootCause: Push provider deprecated a legacy API used by old app builds.
history.resolution: Forced upgrade prompt for affected versions.

history.title: SIP debits delayed for one partner bank
history.symptoms: Debit confirmations from one bank took 10+ minutes.
history.rootCause: Partner bank batch processing slowdown at their end.
history.resolution: Bank recovered; debits confirmed later the same day.

history.title: Users locked out after OTP rate limit change
history.symptoms: Some users could not request an OTP after two attempts.
history.rootCause: OTP request limit lowered from 5 to 2 per 10 minutes by mistake.

history.title: Payout batch paused by duplicate-check alarm
history.symptoms: Afternoon payout batch paused for 30 minutes.
history.rootCause: Duplicate-payout guard tripped on a legitimate split redemption.
history.resolution: Guard now groups by redemption id.

history.title: After-market orders failing during broker maintenance
history.symptoms: AMO orders rejected between 18:00 and 18:40 IST.
history.rootCause: Broker maintenance window not reflected in our AMO acceptance.

history.title: Duplicate SIP reminder notifications
history.symptoms: Users received two SIP reminder pushes.
history.rootCause: Reminder job ran twice after a scheduler leader election.
history.resolution: Added idempotency key on reminder sends.

history.title: Slow portfolio pages during database maintenance
history.symptoms: Portfolio p95 latency rose to 900 ms for 20 minutes.
history.rootCause: A manual VACUUM on the holdings table ran during business hours.
history.resolution: Maintenance moved to the night window; added a guard to the runbook.

history.title: Redemptions not credited on a bank holiday
history.symptoms: Users complained redemptions were not credited same day.
history.rootCause: Bank holiday; payout rails closed. Expected behaviour, unclear messaging.
history.resolution: App now shows expected credit date on holidays.

history.title: Fund orders placed after cut-off got the wrong NAV date
history.symptoms: Users who bought liquid funds at 13:58 IST were given next-day NAV.
history.rootCause: Cut-off comparison used server time without network delay allowance.
history.resolution: Cut-off check moved to the RTA acknowledgement time; affected orders corrected.

history.title: Database connection spike after a batch job
history.symptoms: Active connections hit 85% of max for 10 minutes; no user impact.
history.rootCause: Reconciliation job opened one connection per worker without pooling.
history.resolution: Job now uses the shared pool.

history.title: Stock prices frozen for 6 minutes during market hours
history.symptoms: Prices on watchlists stopped updating mid-session.
history.rootCause: Broker price-feed websocket dropped and our reconnect backoff was too long.
history.resolution: Reduced reconnect backoff; added a staleness alarm on price_feed_lag_ms.
